name: opening-local-dry-van-hourly
about: P3 Home on time: Local dry van by the hour, home daily, dedicated account.

brief.subject: Class A local dry van driver

recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck pulling into a quiet {street} at dusk, a porch light on, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: The truck rolls to a stop as the porch light comes on

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics is hiring a Class A local driver for dedicated dry van work. You run Chicagoland store deliveries and sleep in your own bed every night. Pay starts at $28 per hour and goes to $32 per hour. Paid time off included. Must be 23+.
en.headline: Local runs. $28–$32/hr.

es.primary_text: 360 Logistics necesita conductor Clase A para rutas locales con carga seca dedicada. Entregas a tiendas en el área de Chicago, y llegas a casa cada noche. El pago es de $28 por hora, hasta $32 por hora. Tiempo libre pagado incluido. Mayores de 23.
es.headline: Local. $28–$32 por hora.

en.primary_text: With 360 Logistics you stay local — dedicated dry van, Chicagoland store deliveries, home daily. You earn $28 per hour to start, up to $32 per hour, plus paid time off. Class A CDL and 2 years of experience required. Must be 23+.
en.headline: Home daily with 360.

es.primary_text: Con 360 Logistics: rutas locales, tráiler seco dedicado, entregas en Chicagoland, en casa cada día. De $28 a $32 por hora más tiempo libre pagado. CDL Clase A y 2 años de experiencia. Mayores de 23.
es.headline: A casa cada día con 360.

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics has a dedicated local seat open. You haul dry van freight to Chicagoland stores and you are home every day. Two years of Class A experience required. Must be 23+. Pay is $28 per hour, with top drivers earning $32 per hour. Paid time off included.
en.headline: Class A. $28–$32 hr.

es.primary_text: 360 Logistics tiene un puesto local dedicado disponible. Manejas tráiler seco a tiendas en Chicagoland y llegas a casa cada día. Se requieren 2 años de experiencia con CDL Clase A. Mayores de 23. Pago de $28 por hora, llegando a $32 por hora. Tiempo libre pagado.
es.headline: Clase A. $28–$32 por hora.
